defects.description: The 'keys ignored in help' assertion checks m.Outcome != Quit, but Quit is the zero value of Outcome, so a regression where q quits from the overlay would not be caught (the returned tea.Cmd is discarded by press). A reviewer probe on a copy confirmed the implementation does ignore q (cmd nil, help still open); only the test is vacuous for that key.
Doc comment names the helper ulCells while the function is ulText.

No unit test covers the truncation path where the cut falls inside an underlined span (the trailing SGR 24 safeguard). Reviewer probe at 60 columns showed the output is well-formed (empty SGR 4/24 pair plus closing SGR 24, then reset), so this is a coverage gap, not a behaviour defect.

Highlight matching runs on the sanitized rune slice (control chars replaced by U+FFFD) while profile.Filter matches the raw string, so a filter containing U+FFFD could underline a sanitized control character that Filter did not match on. Not reachable with validated profiles in practice; noted for consistency.

probes: Reviewer ran go test (probe test in a private copy of prototypes/go, deleted afterwards): truncation inside an underline, q inside help, and U+0130 folding; all behaved correctly (go test ok). go vet ./... exit 0 in the copy.
